description: Implement a trampolining mechanism that allows pinned workflows to detect when their target deployment version has changed and optionally upgrade to the new version via continue-as-new. This provides a clean separation between version change detection and continue-as-new suggestions to prevent infinite loops.
functional_requirements: Add a GetTargetWorkflowDeploymentVersionChanged() method to WorkflowInfo that returns a boolean indicating if the workflow's target deployment version has changed since execution started
Create a ContinueAsNewVersioningBehavior type with an AutoUpgrade option that can be set on ContinueAsNewError/ContinueAsNewErrorOptions
Add a ContinueAsNewSuggestedReason enum and GetContinueAsNewSuggestedReasons() method on WorkflowInfo to retrieve suggested reasons for continuing as new
Implement test suite support via SetContinueAsNewSuggestedReasons() and SetTargetWorkflowDeploymentVersionChanged() methods for testing the trampolining flow
Create integration tests demonstrating the full trampolining flow where a v1 pinned workflow detects version change, performs continue-as-new with AutoUpgrade, and completes execution on v2
